plugins.name: nemo-builder
plugins.description: Comprehensive Claude Code skill for building AI solutions using NVIDIA NeMo 2.0 framework

plugins.name: jira-manager
plugins.description: Generate structured Jira tickets and integrate with Jira Server API. Supports templates for bugs, tasks, stories, and epics with per-directory configuration.

plugins.name: python-dev
plugins.description: Pre-commit hooks for code quality: ruff + ty (Python linting, formatting, type checking) and yamllint (YAML validation). Runs on staged files before git commit.

plugins.name: acli-manager
plugins.description: Atlassian CLI (acli) skill for managing Jira Cloud and Confluence Cloud from the command line. Covers work items, projects, boards, sprints, spaces, bulk operations, and automation workflows.

plugins.name: pr-reviewer
plugins.description: PR/MR review with GitHub and GitLab support. Runs specialized agents, validates findings, posts inline comments.

plugins.name: autoresearch
plugins.description: Autonomous hyperparameter/model optimization with parallel GPU researchers using Agent Teams

plugins.name: pdf-design-system
plugins.description: Convert markdown to PDF using a canonical editorial design system (navy/gold/cream, Fraunces + Source Serif 4 + JetBrains Mono). Provides the canonical stylesheet, pandoc + WeasyPrint workflow, and a slash command to scaffold per-project token overrides.

plugins.name: icloud-mcp
plugins.description: Local MCP server (Rust) for Apple iCloud Calendar (CalDAV) and Mail (IMAP). Read + create-only: list/search/create events, list folders, search/fetch messages, and APPEND drafts to the Drafts folder. No SMTP - user reviews drafts and sends manually in iCloud Mail.

plugins.name: monobank-mcp
plugins.description: Local MCP server + CLI (Rust) for Monobank Personal API. Slim ingest: pulls statements into a shared SQLite store and exposes ensure_synced / get_sync_status / list_mono_accounts tools. Query, reports, and categorisation are handled by the personal-finance plugin.

plugins.name: privat24-skill
plugins.description: Import Privat24 web-cabinet statement exports (XLSX) into the shared ~/finances/data.db SQLite store. Owns the privat_* tables. Standalone; companion to monobank-mcp and personal-finance plugins.

plugins.name: personal-finance
plugins.description: Umbrella skill for personal finance queries, reports, categorization, and conversation-driven budgeting over the shared ~/finances/data.db. Auto-discovers <bank>_transactions tables (mono_*, privat_*) and projects them to a common shape. Owns the pf_* family of tables (categorization rules + overrides, budgets + drafts, category registry, import audit). Ships pf-query, pf-report, pf-categorize, pf-rules, and pf-budget (with conversation-driven planning + Family export view).
